title: eng-hiring-onboarding-weekly-sync-2026-03-03
content:
Attendees: Ava Chen (TL), Diego Ramos (Recruiter), Priya Nair (Hiring manager), Ethan Blake (SWE interviewer), Maya Patel (onboarding buddy)

Meeting purpose: Weekly sync for hiring pipeline, interview debriefs, onboarding status and team health checkpoints. Quick standup format - 30 minutes.

1) Hiring pipeline update
- Open reqs / priority roles:
  - Staff ML Engineer (serving runtime) - 4th onsite scheduled (Mar 10). Strong candidate pool; top candidate (Cand A) advanced to final loop.
  - Senior Infra SWE - 2nd-round takehome in progress; feedback expected by 2026-03-05.
  - Backend SWE (core infra) - paused, budget review pending (ENG-456).
- Sourcing notes: Diego ramped up outreach to Kernel and HFT-focused channels; referral from Maya for candidate Cand B (infra ops) - Diego to schedule phone screen.
- Hiring metric highlights (weekly):
  - New screens scheduled: 6 (up from 4 last week)
  - Onsite conversions: 2 offers extended last month, 1 accepted
  - Time-to-offer median: 25 days (target 28)

2) Interview debriefs (quick bullets, consensus and next step)
- Cand A (Staff ML Engineer) - interview date 2026-03-02
  - Strengths: architecture design, performance tuning experience, KV cache reasoning, strong comms
  - Concerns: quantization experience depth uncertain, limited distributed training ops exposure
  - Score: strong hire (4/5)
  - Decision: proceed to final loop with exec/PM. Owner: Priya.
- Cand C (Senior Infra SWE) - takehome reviewed 2026-02-28
  - Strengths: clean code, good fault tolerance thinking
  - Concerns: limited exposure to GPU tooling - schedule specific GPU systems question in next loop
  - Score: hire-with-probe (3/5)
  - Action: Ethan to run technical deep-dive (30m) and report back by 2026-03-05.
- Cand B (Infra Ops, referral) - phone screen pending
  - Action: Diego to schedule with Maya as the first interviewer.

Notes-to-self: capture rubric gap for GPU/quantization signals - add explicit rubric items for interviewers (see onboarding playbook linked).

3) Onboarding updates (new hires & progress)
- New joiners this month:
  - Ravi Singh (SRE) - started 2026-02-23; provisioning: laptop delivered, VPN and Okta done, KMS access pending (ticket #IT-312). Buddy: Maya.
  - Hannah Li (Backend SWE) - start date 2026-03-02; orientation completed, first-week plan sent, mentoring sessions scheduled with Priya.
- Onboarding checklist status (high level):
  - Accounts/provisioning: 80% complete across new hires
  - Core trainings completed: infra overview, codebase walkthrough (recorded)
  - First PR target: day 10 for non-critical bugfixs
- Blockers:
  - KMS/HSM keys for SRE envs slow - security approval queue 2-3 business days. Action: Ethan to escalate with Security (ticket provided).
  - Devstack flaky on Mac M-series for quantization tests - note for DevEx to add Linux VM image to onboarding doc. Owner: Ava.

4) Team health & pulse
- Quick pulse check (verbal): generally +1 to steady morale; stress noted around on-call rotations and hiring load.
- On-call distribution: rotating to cover Dedicated infra tests; two engineers flagged for schedule conflicts in Apr - Priya to coordinate coverage and propose swap options by 2026-03-06.
- Retro items from last week: onboarding docs were tedious for new SRE - actioned to rewrite the RAID section to be more prescriptive (owner: Maya).

5) Admin / process improvements
- Interview rubric update: add explicit quantization/GPU question for ML infra roles; standardize scoring scale across interviewers. Owner: Priya. Due: 2026-03-10.
- New interviewer onboarding: create a 15-20m training for behavioral vs technical scoring - Diego to draft slides; reviewers: Ava + Ethan.
- Offer process tweak: include clear career leveling justification in offer packet to reduce negotiation churn. Owner: Ava + Recruiting.

6) Action items (owner + due date)
- Priya: Schedule Cand A final loop and coordinate exec slot (due 2026-03-07).
- Ethan: Run GPU technical deep-dive for Cand C and escalate KMS blocker with Security (due 2026-03-05).
- Diego: Schedule Cand B phone screen and prep intake doc for referral (due 2026-03-04).
- Maya: Rewrite RAID section of SRE onboarding doc and add Mac/Linux notes (due 2026-03-09).
- Ava: Add Linux VM image note to devstack onboarding and finalize offer packet leveling language (due 2026-03-10).

7) Parking lot / questions
- Should we open an additional Staff ML role in APAC region? (Cost + hiring pipeline discussion) - put on next week's agenda.
- Consider short-term contractor for Dedicated infra tests during hiring gap - Diego to price 4-week engagement.

Next sync: 2026-03-10, 11:00am PT.

Informal notes / fragments (copied from Slack):
- "Heads-up: SSH keys rotating on 3/5 - remind new hires to re-add keys." - SRE channel
- "Candidate Cand A mentioned prior experience with XLA - useful callout for tuning convo." - Ethan

Document history: working notes for hiring/onboarding; will push finalized rubric and onboarding checklist to Confluence after Priya + Maya sign-off.

-- end of notes --
